content: Are you sure you want to register for this game?

After successfully registering for the game and passing the review, the team will be locked and you will no longer be able to remove any member from the team. The team will be unlocked after the game ends or when the participation request is rejected.
The limit on the number of players refers to the number of members that have decided to participate as part of the specific team, regardless of which team you choose to play with.

koh.copy_token: Copy token, write it into /koh/king on any hill

hill.check: The table above and this call show who the platform recorded as holder in the last scored tick.
hill.cookie: Use the token above, or fetch it from a script. Scripts sign in with your GZCTF_Token browser cookie, which you can copy from the developer tools. It is your login session, so keep it private.
hill.entry: entry is host:port, or a container id when the platform proxy is enabled. For a container id, the panel in the challenge shows the full WebSocket address.
hill.plant: Exploit the hill however its vulnerability allows, then write the exact token into /koh/king. Surrounding whitespace is ignored.
hill.title: Take a hill

guide.intro: Every team attacks the same container, the hill. Write your team's token into /koh/king on a hill to take it, and keep the service working to score each tick.

refresh.entry: A reset launches a new container, so the address of the hill can change. Fetch it again after each reset.
refresh.title: Resets
refresh.token: Your token rotates at the same moment. A token from an earlier window no longer counts.
refresh.wipe: Every {{ticks}} ticks each hill is reset to its base image. Footholds, patches and the marker are all wiped.

scoring.board: King of the Hill points are shown on their own scoreboard tab and are not added to the jeopardy score.
scoring.check: Once per tick, at a random moment in roughly the first half of the tick, the platform reads /koh/king and checks that the service works.
scoring.fault: A checker or platform fault (InternalError) never gives or takes points.
scoring.grace: If you did not hold the hill in either of the two previous ticks, you are not penalized for a broken hill.
scoring.hold: If your token is there and the service is healthy, your team earns the game's points per tick.
scoring.penalty: If your token is there and the service is broken (Mumble or Offline), your team loses 1 point for that tick.
scoring.title: How scoring works

tips.keep: Keep your token in place for the whole tick. Other teams can overwrite it at any time, and you cannot predict when the check runs.
tips.replay: A token copied from /koh/king scores for the team it belongs to, not for whoever wrote it.
tips.script: Script the whole loop of fetching the token, exploiting and writing the marker, so you are back on the hill quickly after a reset.
tips.service: Keep the service running. Breaking the hill you hold costs you points every tick.
tips.title: Tips
